blocks.text: **go** — «bormoq», ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llardan biri (go — went — gone). O'zbekchada «bormoq» ga kelishik qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi: maktab**ga** bormoq, sayr**ga** chiqmoq, baliq ovla**gani** bormoq. Inglizchada go dan keyingi so'z **predlog** bilan bog'lanadi va har bir predlogning o'z vazifasi bor: **go to** (joyga), **go on** (safar, ta'til), **go for** (qisqa mashg'ulot, ovqat), **go + -ing** (sport, dam olish). Qolipni noto'g'ri tanlash — o'zbeklarning eng ko'p uchraydigan xatolaridan biri.

go on holiday, go on a trip, go on a tour

blocks.text: Biror joyga borishni **go to** bildiradi: go **to** the cinema, go **to** the doctor, go **to** Samarkand. Ba'zi so'zlar the siz keladi, chunki ular joyning **vazifasini** bildiradi: go to **work**, go to **school**, go to **university**, go to **bed** (uxlashga yotmoq), go to **hospital** (davolanishga yotmoq) — 71-dars. O'tgan zamon — **went**: We **went to** the theatre last night.

items.text: I usually **go to bed** at eleven.
Shall we **go to the cinema** tonight?

blocks.text: go home, go abroad — to siz

**home**, **there**, **here**, **abroad**, **somewhere**, **anywhere**, **upstairs / downstairs** oldidan **to qo'yilmaydi**, chunki bu so'zlarning o'zida «-ga» ma'nosi bor: go **home** — «uyga bormoq», go **abroad** — «chet elga chiqmoq», go **there** — «u yerga bormoq». «go to home» — o'zbeklarning eng tipik xatosi: «uy**ga**» dagi «-ga» ni to bilan tarjima qilib yuborishadi.

items.text: My brother often **goes abroad** for work.
items.translation: Akam ish bilan tez-tez **chet elga chiqadi**.

blocks.text: 2. go on holiday, go on a trip

**go on** — uzoqroq yoki rejalashtirilgan safarlar uchun: go on **holiday** (ta'tilga chiqmoq — artiklsiz!), go on **a trip** (safarga chiqmoq), go on **a tour** (ekskursiyaga chiqmoq), go on **a business trip** (xizmat safariga ketmoq), go on **a cruise** (kemada sayohat qilmoq). Bundan tashqari go on **strike** — «ish tashlamoq». Holat haqida gapirganda **be on**: She**'s on holiday** — «U ta'tilda».

items.text: My parents **went on a trip** to Khiva.
Next week James **is going on a business trip**.

blocks.text: 3. go for a walk, go for a swim

**go for a** + ot — qisqa mashg'ulot yoki ovqat uchun chiqish: go for **a walk** (sayrga chiqmoq), **a run** (yugurgani chiqmoq), **a swim** (cho'milgani bormoq), **a drink** / **a coffee** (biror narsa ichgani bormoq), **a meal** (ovqatlangani bormoq), **a drive** / **a bike ride** (mashinada / velosipedda aylangani chiqmoq). Bu yerdagi **for** — 54-darsdagi «for + ot» maqsad: go out **for** dinner.

items.text: After lunch we **went for a walk** by the river.
items.translation: Tushlikdan keyin daryo bo'yida **sayr qilgani chiqdik**.

items.text: Do you want to **go for a coffee**?

blocks.text: Sport va dam olish faoliyatlari uchun **go + -ing**: go shopping, go swimming, go fishing, go skiing, go running, go dancing, go camping, go sightseeing. Orada **to yo'q**: «go to shopping» — xato. O'zbekchada bu ko'pincha «-gani bormoq» yoki «-ga bormoq»: baliq ovla**gani** bormoq, raqs**ga** bormoq. Present Perfect da ko'pincha **been** ishlatiladi: Have you ever **been skiing**? — «Hech chang'i uchganmisiz?» (been va gone farqi — 17-dars).

**go swimming** va **go for a swim** — ma'nosi deyarli bir xil. Farqi: go swimming — ko'pincha odatiy mashg'ulot (I go swimming twice a week), go for a swim — bir martalik, qisqa (Let's go for a swim before dinner). Xuddi shunday: go running / go for a run.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «go to home» → **go home**; «go to shopping» → **go shopping**; «I went to swimming.» → **I went swimming.**; «go to holiday» → **go on holiday**; «go to abroad» → **go abroad**; «We went to a walk.» → **We went for a walk.** (Britaniyada «go on a walk» emas, **go for a walk**).

Eslab qolish: **to** — joyga (qayerga?), **on** — safarga (holiday, trip, tour), **for** — qisqa bir narsaga (a walk, a swim, a coffee), **-ing** — faoliyatga (shopping, fishing). home, abroad, there — to siz.

examples.title: **go to** + place: work, school, the bank
examples.description: Biror joyga borish — go to + joy. work, school, bed, university kabi so'zlar the siz (71-dars); boshqa joylar ko'pincha the bilan: go to the bank, go to the doctor.

sentences.text: I **go to work** by metro every day.
sentences.translation: Har kuni **ishga** metroda **boraman**.

sentences.text: What time do your children **go to bed**?
sentences.translation: Bolalaringiz soat nechada **uxlashga yotishadi**?

sentences.text: Aziz **went to the doctor** because of a bad cough.
sentences.translation: Aziz qattiq yo'tal tufayli **shifokorga bordi**.

sentences.text: We **go to the cinema** about once a month.
sentences.translation: Biz oyiga bir martacha **kinoga boramiz**.

sentences.text: Next September my little brother **will go to school** for the first time.
sentences.translation: Kelasi sentabrda ukam birinchi marta **maktabga boradi**.

sentences.text: Has Emma **gone to the bank**? — Yes, she'll be back soon.
sentences.translation: Emma **bankka ketdimi**? — Ha, hozir qaytadi.

sentences.text: Last night Dilnoza **went to a concert** with her friends.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun Dilnoza dugonalari bilan **konsertga bordi**.

sentences.text: Do you **go to the mosque** on Fridays?
sentences.translation: Juma kunlari **masjidga borasizmi**?

sentences.text: In summer many families **go to the mountains** near Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Yozda ko'p oilalar Toshkent yaqinidagi **tog'larga borishadi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is going to London** next week to visit his sister.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kelasi hafta singlisini ko'rgani **Londonga boryapti**.

examples.title: **go home**, **go there**, **go abroad** — no **to**
examples.description: home, there, here, abroad, somewhere, upstairs / downstairs oldidan to qo'yilmaydi: go home — uyga bormoq, go abroad — chet elga chiqmoq. «go to home» — xato.

sentences.text: It's late — let's **go home**.
sentences.translation: Kech bo'ldi — **uyga ketaylik**.

sentences.text: Sarah **went home** early because she felt ill.
sentences.translation: Sara o'zini yomon his qilgani uchun **uyga** erta **ketdi**.

sentences.text: Do you often **go abroad** for work?
sentences.translation: Ish bilan tez-tez **chet elga chiqasizmi**?

sentences.text: The museum is lovely. We **went there** last summer.
sentences.translation: Muzey juda ajoyib. O'tgan yozda **u yerga borgandik**.

sentences.text: My parents never **go anywhere** without their phones.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam telefonsiz hech **qayerga bormaydi**.

sentences.text: Shall we **go somewhere** nice for my birthday?
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kunimda biror yaxshi **joyga boraylikmi**?

sentences.text: After the party Tom **didn't go home** — he stayed at a friend's.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatdan keyin Tom **uyga ketmadi** — do'stinikida qoldi.

sentences.text: Madina wants to **go abroad** to study medicine.
sentences.translation: Madina tibbiyot o'qish uchun **chet elga ketmoqchi**.

sentences.text: **Go upstairs** and tell your brother that dinner's ready.
sentences.translation: **Yuqoriga chiq** va akangga ovqat tayyorligini ayt.

sentences.text: When I finish work, I usually **go straight home**.
sentences.translation: Ishni tugatganimda odatda **to'g'ri uyga ketaman**.

examples.title: **go on** holiday, **go on** a trip, **go on** a tour
examples.description: Sayohat va safar turlari — go on + ...: go on holiday (ta'tilga chiqmoq), go on a trip (safarga chiqmoq), go on a tour, go on a business trip. Shuningdek: go on strike (ish tashlamoq).

sentences.text: We **go on holiday** every August.
sentences.translation: Har avgustda **ta'tilga chiqamiz**.

sentences.text: Where **are** you **going on holiday** this year?
sentences.translation: Bu yil **ta'tilga** qayerga **ketyapsiz**?

sentences.text: My father **went on a business trip** to Moscow last week.
sentences.translation: Dadam o'tgan hafta Moskvaga **xizmat safariga ketdi**.

sentences.text: The students **are going on a school trip** to Samarkand.
sentences.translation: O'quvchilar Samarqandga **maktab sayohatiga borishyapti**.

sentences.text: Did you **go on a boat trip** in Istanbul? — Yes, it was amazing.
sentences.translation: Istanbulda **qayiqda sayr qildingizmi**? — Ha, ajoyib bo'ldi.

sentences.text: In London we **went on a bus tour** of the city.
sentences.translation: Londonda shahar bo'ylab **avtobus ekskursiyasiga chiqdik**.

sentences.text: Bus drivers **went on strike** yesterday, so I walked to work.
sentences.translation: Kecha avtobus haydovchilari **ish tashlashdi**, shuning uchun ishga piyoda bordim.

sentences.text: James and Emma **are going on honeymoon** to Italy.
sentences.translation: Jeyms bilan Emma **asal oyiga** Italiyaga **ketishyapti**.

sentences.text: I can't **go on holiday** this summer because I have too much work.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz **ta'tilga chiqa olmayman**, chunki ishim juda ko'p.

sentences.text: Before Aziz **went on his trip**, he bought a new camera.
sentences.translation: Aziz **safarga chiqishdan** oldin yangi fotoapparat sotib oldi.

examples.title: **go for** a walk, **go for** a run, **go for** a meal
examples.description: Qisqa mashg'ulot yoki ovqat uchun chiqish — go for + a + ot: go for a walk, a run, a swim, a coffee, a meal, a bike ride. O'zbekchadagi «-ga chiqmoq», «-gani bormoq».

sentences.text: Let's **go for a walk** in the park.
sentences.translation: Parkda **sayr qilgani chiqaylik**.

sentences.text: Every evening my grandfather **goes for a walk** after dinner.
sentences.translation: Har kuni kechqurun bobom kechki ovqatdan keyin **sayrga chiqadi**.

sentences.text: Emma **went for a run** before breakfast.
sentences.translation: Emma nonushtadan oldin **yugurgani chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Would you like to **go for a coffee** after the lesson?
sentences.translation: Darsdan keyin **qahva ichgani borasizmi**?

sentences.text: On hot days we **go for a swim** in the lake.
sentences.translation: Issiq kunlarda ko'lga **cho'milgani boramiz**.

sentences.text: Bekzod and his colleagues **went for a meal** to celebrate the new contract.
sentences.translation: Bekzod va hamkasblari yangi shartnomani nishonlash uchun **restoranga ovqatlangani borishdi**.

sentences.text: Are you **going for a drink** with Tom after work?
sentences.translation: Ishdan keyin Tom bilan **biror narsa ichgani borasizmi**?

sentences.text: It was a sunny day, so we **went for a drive** in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Kun quyoshli edi, shuning uchun **mashinada tog'larga aylangani chiqdik**.

sentences.text: Why don't you **go for a bike ride**? The weather's perfect.
sentences.translation: Nega **velosipedda aylangani chiqmaysiz**? Havo ajoyib.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **didn't go for a swim** because the water was too cold.
sentences.translation: Suv juda sovuq bo'lgani uchun Dilnoza **cho'milgani bormadi**.

examples.title: **go** + **-ing**: go shopping, go swimming, go fishing
examples.description: Sport va dam olish faoliyatlari — go + -ing: go shopping, swimming, fishing, skiing, running, dancing, camping. Orada to yo'q: «go to shopping» — xato.

sentences.text: On Saturdays I usually **go shopping** with my mum.
sentences.translation: Shanba kunlari odatda oyim bilan **xarid qilgani boraman**.

sentences.text: Do you want to **go swimming** this afternoon?
sentences.translation: Bugun tushdan keyin **suzgani borishni** xohlaysizmi?

sentences.text: My uncle **goes fishing** every Sunday.
sentences.translation: Amakim har yakshanba **baliq oviga boradi**.

sentences.text: Last winter we **went skiing** in Chimgan.
sentences.translation: O'tgan qish Chimyonda **chang'i uchgani bordik**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has gone running** — she'll be back in half an hour.
sentences.translation: Sara **yugurgani ketgan** — yarim soatdan keyin qaytadi.

sentences.text: Shall we **go dancing** on Friday night?
sentences.translation: Juma kuni kechqurun **raqsga boraylikmi**?

sentences.text: James has never **been sailing**, but he'd love to try.
sentences.translation: Jeyms hech qachon **yelkanli qayiqda suzmagan**, lekin sinab ko'rishni juda xohlaydi.

sentences.text: In summer the whole family **goes camping** by the lake.
sentences.translation: Yozda butun oila ko'l bo'yiga **chodirda dam olgani boradi**.

sentences.text: We **went sightseeing** in Bukhara all day and saw many beautiful old buildings.
sentences.translation: Butun kun Buxoroda **diqqatga sazovor joylarni aylandik** va ko'plab chiroyli qadimiy binolarni ko'rdik.

sentences.text: Madina **doesn't go jogging** in winter because it's too cold.
sentences.translation: Madina qishda **yugurgani chiqmaydi**, chunki juda sovuq bo'ladi.

examples.title: Questions and answers with **go**
examples.description: go bilan savol va qisqa javoblar: Where did you go? — We went ... Qaysi qolip (to / on / for / -ing) kerakligiga e'tibor bering.

sentences.text: Where **did** you **go** last weekend? — We **went to the seaside**.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari qayerga **bordingiz**? — **Dengiz bo'yiga bordik**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **going out** tonight? — No, I'm staying in.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **ko'chaga chiqasizmi**? — Yo'q, uyda qolaman.

sentences.text: **Did** Aziz **go to the meeting**? — No, he was ill.
sentences.translation: Aziz **yig'ilishga bordimi**? — Yo'q, kasal edi.

sentences.text: How often **do** you **go swimming**? — Twice a week.
sentences.translation: Qanchalik tez-tez **suzgani borasiz**? — Haftasiga ikki marta.

sentences.text: **Has** Bekzod **gone on holiday**? — Yes, he's in Antalya.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **ta'tilga chiqdimi**? — Ha, u Antalyada.

sentences.text: Who **went for a walk** with the dog? — Dilnoza did.
sentences.translation: Itni olib kim **sayrga chiqdi**? — Dilnoza.

sentences.text: When **are** your parents **going to Samarkand**? — On Friday morning.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz **Samarqandga** qachon **ketishyapti**? — Juma kuni ertalab.

sentences.text: Why **didn't** you **go to school** today? — I had a temperature.
sentences.translation: Bugun nega **maktabga bormading**? — Isitmam bor edi.

sentences.text: **Do** you ever **go fishing** with your dad? — Sometimes, in summer.
sentences.translation: Dadang bilan hech **baliq oviga borasanmi**? — Ba'zan, yozda.

sentences.text: Which city **did** you **go to** on your last business trip? — Manchester.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi xizmat safaringizda qaysi **shaharga bordingiz**? — Manchesterga.

examples.title: Mixed: **go to**, **go on**, **go for** or **go -ing**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bitta gapda go ning ikki xil qolipi.

sentences.text: In the morning we **went shopping**, and in the afternoon we **went for a swim**.
sentences.translation: Ertalab **xarid qilgani bordik**, tushdan keyin esa **cho'milgani bordik**.

sentences.text: My sister **goes to university** in Tashkent and **goes home** every weekend.
sentences.translation: Opam Toshkentda **universitetda o'qiydi** va har dam olish kunlari **uyga boradi**.

sentences.text: Tom **is going on a trip** to Scotland, and he wants to **go climbing** there.
sentences.translation: Tom Shotlandiyaga **safarga ketyapti** va u yerda **tog'ga chiqmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Before we **go to bed**, let's **go for a short walk**.
sentences.translation: **Uxlashdan** oldin biroz **sayr qilib kelaylik**.

sentences.text: Did you **go on holiday** last year, or did you **go to work** all summer?
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili **ta'tilga chiqdingizmi** yoki butun yoz **ishga qatnadingizmi**?

sentences.text: Madina **went to the market** for vegetables and then **went home** to cook.
sentences.translation: Madina sabzavot olgani **bozorga bordi**, keyin ovqat pishirgani **uyga ketdi**.

sentences.text: We can't **go skiing** this year, so we're **going to the seaside** instead.
sentences.translation: Bu yil **chang'i uchgani bora olmaymiz**, shuning uchun o'rniga **dengiz bo'yiga ketyapmiz**.

sentences.text: After work Bekzod **goes to the gym** or **goes running** in the park.
sentences.translation: Ishdan keyin Bekzod **sport zaliga boradi** yoki parkda **yugurgani chiqadi**.

sentences.text: Emma **has gone to Oxford** for a conference, so she can't **go out** with us tonight.
sentences.translation: Emma konferensiyaga **Oksfordga ketgan**, shuning uchun bugun kechqurun biz bilan **ko'chaga chiqa olmaydi**.

sentences.text: Shall we **go for a meal** first and then **go dancing**?
sentences.translation: Avval **ovqatlangani boraylikmi**, keyin **raqsga**?

examples.title: Dialogue: plans for the holidays
examples.description: Suhbatda go ning barcha qoliplari: go to, go on a trip, go on holiday, go for, go + -ing, go home.

sentences.text: — Are you **going away** for the holidays, Madina?
sentences.translation: — Bayramda biror joyga **ketyapsanmi**, Madina?

sentences.text: — Yes, we**'re going to Bukhara** to see my grandparents.
sentences.translation: — Ha, bobom va buvimni ko'rgani **Buxoroga ketyapmiz**.

sentences.text: — Lovely! Will you **go sightseeing**?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! **Shaharni aylanasizlarmi**?

sentences.text: — Of course. And my brother wants to **go fishing** with Grandpa.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Akam esa bobom bilan **baliq oviga bormoqchi**.

sentences.text: — Do you **go there** every year?
sentences.translation: — **U yerga** har yili **borasizlarmi**?

sentences.text: — Almost. Last year we **went on a trip** to Khiva instead.
sentences.translation: — Deyarli. O'tgan yili esa o'rniga Xivaga **sayohatga bordik**.

sentences.text: — We never **go on holiday** — my parents work all the time.
sentences.translation: — Biz hech qachon **ta'tilga chiqmaymiz** — ota-onam doim ishlashadi.

sentences.text: — Then come with us! We can **go for long walks** in the old town.
sentences.translation: — Unda biz bilan yur! Eski shaharda uzoq **sayr qilamiz**.

sentences.text: — Really? I**'ll go home** and ask my mum tonight.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? **Uyga borib**, bugun kechqurun oyimdan so'rayman.

sentences.text: — Great! Call me when you know, and we**'ll go shopping** for the trip.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Bilganingda qo'ng'iroq qil, safar uchun **xarid qilgani boramiz**.
